name: Honda CB750 Nighthawk
engine: 747 cc air-cooled DOHC inline four, four carbs
intro: A plain, long-lived Honda four. Many sat for years, so carbs and charging are the usual jobs.

G: A lot of Nighthawks sat in garages for years. Plan on a full carb clean and sync.
A: Almost every part interchanges across 1991-2003, which makes used parts easy to find.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Stored bikes
known.what: Many sat for years before resale.
